
// AAASeed uniform implicit / OpenGL
// updated 2024 May 22 by Maa
// Dimension of textures : 0, 1, 2, 3 dimension, -1 if unused per Tex Unit
uniform	int			aaa_tex_dim[4];

// Mapping method per tex unit
uniform int			aaa_tex_gen[4];

// Textures
uniform sampler2D	aaa_tex2d[4];

// Tex env mode per tex unit
uniform int			aaa_tex_env_mode[4];

//	8 x 4bits per lights
uniform uint		aaa_lights;

Example for lights
	//	parse 4 bits by 4 bits ( 8 lights )
	uint lights = aaa_lights;
	for( int i=0; i<LIGHT_NB; ++i )
	{
		int one = int(lights) & 0xf;
		if( one!=0 )
		{
			if( one == 1 )
				directionalLight( i, normal );
			else if( one == 2 )
				pointLight( i, normal, eye, ecPosition3 );
			else
				spotLight( i, normal, eye, ecPosition3 );
		}
		lights >>= 4u;
		if( lights==0u )	//	avoid rest of loop
			break;
	}



// Size of Texture for each texture unit
uniform vec2	aaa_tex_0_size to aaa_tex_3_size
	float	aaa_tex_0_size.x;
	float 	aaa_tex_0_size.y;

//	AAAseed uniform vertex shader
uniform float	aaa_vu_float	[8];
uniform int	aaa_vu_int	[4];
uniform vec4	aaa_vu_vec4	[12];

//	AAAseed uniform Geometry shader
uniform float	aaa_gu_float	[4];
uniform int	aaa_gu_int	[4];
uniform vec4	aaa_gu_vec4	[4];

//	AAAseed uniform pixel shader
uniform float	aaa_pu_float	[24];
uniform int	aaa_pu_int	[4];
uniform vec4	aaa_pu_vec4	[8];

//	AAAseed uniform compute shader
uniform float	aaa_cu_float	[24];
uniform int	aaa_cu_int	[4];
uniform vec4	aaa_cu_vec4	[8];
